caption: The drawing depicts a quilt composed of four square blocks, each made up of concentric strips of fabric-like rectangles arranged in a "log cabin" pattern. Each square block has a bright red small square at its center. The top left block has surrounding strips in shades of olive green, brown, dark green, and gray. The top right block is bordered by strips in green, olive, brown, and black, with a touch of red, and the outermost edge is a muted green on the far right. The bottom left block is made with alternating strips of blue, gray, and black, moving outward from the red center. The bottom right block is bordered by brown, tan with a floral design, olive, black, and reddish-brown strips. The entire composition sits on a plain, off-white background, with the artist’s name "Ruth M. Barnes" written in small letters at the bottom right corner.
title: Log Cabin Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
